ταβαίτας.definition: wooden bowl, a Persian word, Amynt. ap. Ath.14.500d

ταγή.definition: line of battle, front; command, province, Arist.Oec.1345b25

τάγμα.definition: ordinance, command; fixed assessment or payment, Id.Oec.1349a24, CIG2562.14

ταγός.definition: commander, ruler, chief; specially, federal commander of Thessalian league, X.HG6.1.6, 6.4.28, etc

ταινία.definition: band, fillet, esp. headband, worn in sign of; strip in fur, Opp.C.1.322

ταλάπης.definition: a plant similar to the PMag.Par.1.812

τάξις.definition: in military sense; drawing up in rank and file, order or disposition of an army, Th.5.68 , 7.5, etc.; rules for it, tactics, X.An.2.1.7; Phld.Piet.12

τάξος.definition: yew, Taxus baccata, Sabin. ap. Orib.9.16.3, Gal.12.127

ταραχή.definition: also , disorder; of an army or fleet, Th.3.77, etc.; in the confusion, in the mêlée, Hdt.3.126

ταῦ.definition: the letter Hp.VC1, Pl.Cra.394c, IG22.2783.20 , Sor.Fasc.45, etc

ταυρίνη.definition: Lat. taurina, a kind of shoe, Edict.Diocl.9.15

ταῦρος.definition: bull, Il.2.481, etc.; as a sacrifice to; priest of Poseidon Taureios, Ath.10.425c

τάφος.definition: funeral-rites, Il.23.619; the act of performing the funeral-rites, S.Ant.534

τάχος.definition: swiftness, speed; quickness of temper, hastiness, E.Ba.670; . . Id.Supp.419; f.l. in Pl.Lg.944c; quickness of apprehension, ib.689c

τέγεος.definition: at or near the roof, of; roofed, Emp.142, and so perh. in Il. l.c., though Apollon.Lex. glosses by

τέγος.definition: any covered hall or chamber, the temple at Delphi, Pi.P.5.41; i.e. in a cave, Id.N.3.54

τρίφθογγος.definition: a triple vowel-sound, Tz.H.12.242: as Adj. having three voices, PMag.Par.1.2820

τισιγίτης.definition: utensil, vessel, Persian word, Alexander ap.Ath.11.784a

ταχύγονος.definition: yielding fruit quickly or soon, Thphr.CP4.3.6

ταλανίζω.definition: call or deem one unhappy, Aesop.113,328, Jo Sic.inRh.6.451 W.:—Pass., Ptol.Tetr.208, Heliod.in EN19.18:—hence Jo.Sic. l.c

τριολύμπιος.definition: consisting of three Olympian goddesses, of the goddesses judged by Paris , S.Fr.511

τριχόβρως.definition: eating hair: hence = or moths, Ar.Ach.1111 )

τρυγῳδός.definition: prop. must-singer or lees- singer, = Ar.V.650 , 1537; v

τορνοειδής.definition: shaped like a circle, rounded, Eust. ad D.P.157

τομάς.definition: v.l. for J.AJ3.1.2; clearing in a forest, IG5.343 A6, 12

ταπείνωσις.definition: lowering, of a movement in; lessening, opp. Arist.PA689a25; reduction of a swelling, Gal.12.816

τραπεζόω.definition: Pass., to be set upon a table, S.Fr.611

τοκισμός.definition: the practice of usury, X.Vect.4.6, Arist.Pol.1258b25

τηλίκος.definition: Dor. of such an age, so; so great, AP7.2.9 ; ib.7.11.4 ; ib.10.64.1 . Adv. Aristaenet.2.9

τέρμα.definition: end, boundary, chiefly poet; goal round which horses and chariots had to turn at races, Il.23.309; ib.462,466; or ib.333,358; Pi.P.9.114; i.e. doubled twelve times, Id.O.3.33; dub. l. in S.El.686; Arist.Rh.1409b23

τετραήμερος.definition: of or lasting four days, in four days, Arist.HA553a10; cf

τελετάρχης.definition: founder of mysteries, Orph.H.54; in pl., an order of divine beings who bring initial and final terms into relation, Dam.Pr.96, al., cf. 277

ταλαπενθής.definition: bearing great griefs, patient in; of things, toilsome, Panyas.12.5; woeful, B.15.26

τρίχα.definition: Adv., in three parts or ways, Il.2.655; Od.8.506; c. gen., 'twas in the third watch of the night, 12.312, 14.483; Hdt.4.67; Pi.O.7.75; Arist.HA503a27; cf. the common Prose form is

τετράλινον.definition: prob. a fourfold lace or string, Gloss

τροχαῖος.definition: running, spinning; a trochee or foot consisting of a long and a short syllable , Pl.R.400b, etc.; used in quick time, Arist.Rh.1408b36, cf. Po.1452b24, and v. :—hence

τετράρριζος.definition: with four roots, Gal.2.753: = dentium dolor, Gloss

τότε.definition: allora, in quel tempo (correlativo di ὅτε)

τοιοῦτος.definition: τοιοῦτος, τοιαύτη, τοιοῦτο(ν): tale, siffatto (dimostrativo di qualità, correl. di οἷος)

τοσοῦτος.definition: τοσοῦτος, τοσαύτη, τοσοῦτο(ν): tanto grande, tanto numeroso (correl. di ὅσος)

τλάω.definition: sopportare, osare, avere il coraggio di: tema τλα-/τλη- senza presente in uso; aor. ἔτλην (imv. τλῆθι), fut. τλήσομαι, pf. τέτληκα (valore di presente)

τέθηπα.definition: sono stupito, attonito: pf. con valore di presente (tema θαπ-/ταφ-); aor. II ἔταφον

τέτμον.definition: raggiunsi, trovai, colsi [epico]: aor. II a raddoppiamento senza presente (anche ἔτετμον)
